tagline: open scientific writing · Diamond Open Access · Latin America
footer_sources: sources: SciELO · DOAJ · Redalyc · LA Referencia
home_title: Write your paper one section at a time
home_intro: CANETA splits the work into sections, reviews each one independently and only suggests moving on after you fix the current one. Citations come from open literature (Diamond Open Access) found for you, never invented.
mode_a_desc: Upload the file (.docx, .odt, .tex, .md or the .zip of a LaTeX project with several files and .bib). CANETA splits it into sections to review one by one.
mode_b_desc: Write one screen at a time (abstract, introduction, methods…). You can upload results and reference papers as a .zip.
open_checkpoint_desc: Continue where you left off with a .caneta file (on any computer).
structure_imrad: IMRaD (abstract, introduction, methods, results, discussion, conclusions)
title: Title
setup_intro: Choose how CANETA will work. You can change everything later.
group_paid_desc: Use a subscription or key you already have: Claude or ChatGPT/Codex. Recommended models: Claude Haiku 5.5 and GPT-6 Luna.
group_free_desc: NVIDIA NIM with a free key (Nemotron models) or Codex with a free ChatGPT account.
group_local_desc: Ollama on your computer: nothing leaves your machine. Needs reasonable hardware.
group_none_desc: The writing is all yours. CANETA finds open citations, suggests journals, checks grounding and fixes grammar.
provider_claude-cli: Uses Claude Code already installed and logged in (Claude subscription).
provider_codex-cli: Uses Codex CLI already installed and logged in (ChatGPT subscription).
provider_anthropic-api: Paste an Anthropic API key (pay per use).
provider_openai-api: Paste an OpenAI API key (pay per use).
provider_nvidia-nim: Free NVIDIA key (free-tier credits and limits).
provider_codex-free: Codex CLI logged in with a free ChatGPT account (GPT-6 Luna; limited quota).
api_key_ph: paste it here (stored in the OS keychain)
nim_help: To get a free key: 1) go to build.nvidia.com and sign in with a free NVIDIA Developer account; 2) open a Nemotron model card and click Get API Key; 3) paste the key (starts with nvapi-). Then use Test models to pick the Nemotron that answers best.
ollama_help: Install Ollama, pull a model (e.g. ollama pull qwen3:8b) and use Test models to list installed models.
codex_free_help: Install Codex CLI (npm install -g @openai/codex), run codex once and sign in with your free ChatGPT account. The free quota is limited.
cli_help: CANETA runs the tool in the background without access to your files: only the section text and the sources found are sent.
model_ph: leave empty to use the recommended one
none_desc: Without AI you write and fix the text. CANETA still searches Diamond Open Access literature, suggests journals, flags uncited claims and (optionally) checks grammar.
lt_public: Public LanguageTool (text is sent to languagetool.org)
privacy_note: Cloud providers receive the text of the sections you send. For confidential work, prefer Ollama (local) or the no-AI mode.
sidebar_hint: Go one section at a time: write, review, fix and approve. Nothing is locked; the order is only a suggestion.
confirm_delete: Delete this section? The text stays in the history.
guide_abstract: Abstract: aim, method, main results (with numbers) and conclusion, without citations.
guide_intro: Introduction: context, gap and aim. Here CANETA searches Diamond Open Access literature and suggests supporting citations.
guide_methods: Methods: enough for someone else to reproduce the work.
guide_results: Results: what you found, with numbers and units. CANETA can download the full text of related work for comparison.
guide_discussion: Discussion: what the results mean, comparison with the literature and limitations.
guide_conclusion: Conclusions: answers to the aim, no new results.
guide_custom: Free section, reviewed independently like the others.
approved_notice: Section approved. To edit again, reopen it (the current version stays in the history).
editor_placeholder: Write here (you can start with bullet points; 'Format and polish' turns them into prose).
cite_hint: Cite with [@key] (see keys under References). Ctrl+S saves.
no_findings: No findings: the section looks ready. Approve it or ask for another round.
no_review_yet: This section has not been reviewed yet.
tool_review_desc: Independent reviewers (editor, methodologist, references) point out problems quoting the exact passage. You decide each one.
tool_polish_desc: Turns bullet points into prose and improves clarity without adding facts or citations. You see the differences before accepting.
tool_edit_desc: Select a passage in the editor (optional) and say what to change. Changes arrive as a diff.
edit_ph: e.g. make this paragraph more direct and spell out the acronym
tool_enrich_desc: Pick references already found; the AI inserts [@key] only where they support the text.
tool_compare_desc: Uses the full text of selected works to propose a comparison paragraph. Numbers are checked against the original text.
no_fulltext_yet: No reference has its full text downloaded yet.
tool_approve_desc: Marks the section as ready and takes you to the next one. Pending items are warnings, not blocks.
history_diff_hint: Differences between this version (struck through) and the current text (highlighted).
confirm_restore: Restore? The current text also stays in the history.
proposal_hint: Nothing has changed yet. Review the differences, adjust the final text if you want, then accept or discard.
refs_intro: Every citation comes from here: Diamond Open Access literature found by CANETA or the material you uploaded. CANETA never invents bibliographic data.
search_desc: Searches all SciELO journals and DOAJ, Diamond Open Access only (no APC). Up to 20 papers, the most recent among the most relevant.
search_tip: Use OR between synonyms and languages: hidroides OR hydroids OR Hydrozoa
material_desc: Results, tables, notes, papers to cite (.zip, .pdf, .csv, .md, .bib, .ris). PDFs are converted to text; .bib/.ris become references.
confirm_remove_ref: Remove this reference from the project?
fetch_fulltext_desc: ≈5–20 s per paper; used to compare results.
no_refs: No references yet. Search open literature or upload a .bib.
results_intro: Tick the papers you want to use. Bibliographic data comes from open databases (SciELO/DOAJ/Crossref).
journal_intro: Suggestions among Diamond Open Access journals indexed in CANETA, comparing each journal's scope with your title, abstract and introduction. You may choose any other.
no_ranking: Write the abstract or introduction to get suggestions.
journal_note: Qualis 2021-2024 (CAPES' last journal Qualis); 2-year mean citedness from OpenAlex (not the JIF). When you choose, CANETA downloads the template from the journal's own site.
export_note: [@key] citations are formatted automatically from the data (CSL-JSON). With a chosen journal, the .docx uses its Word template and the LaTeX .zip uses its LaTeX template (when the journal offers one). Equations become native Word equations, numbered.
checkpoint_desc: A single .caneta file with the whole project (sections, history, reviews, references). Open it on any computer from the home screen.
log_intro: Everything that happened in this project, including every AI call (provider, model and hash of the text sent).
about_link: Learn about the project and the manifesto.
extras_intro: None of this is installed by default. Turn it on only if you need it; the download happens once.
extra_semantic_desc: Local multilingual embeddings (potion-multilingual-128M model): finds journals and papers similar to your text even in another language. Improves journal choice, result ordering and the passages used for comparison. Your text never leaves the computer.
extra_ocr_desc: Only needed for scanned PDFs without a text layer (usually old papers). Recent PDFs convert without OCR. It is slow (≈10–15 s per page, up to 40 pages).
scanned_hint: The PDF has no text layer. Turn on OCR in Settings and download again with the OCR option.
ocr_not_installed: Scanned PDFs need OCR, which is not installed:
semantic_hint: Closeness in meaning to your title and introduction
stale_finding: This passage is no longer in the text: the section changed after this review (e.g. it was polished or edited). Fix it directly in the editor if it still applies and click “Already fixed”, or reject/defer it.
section_busy: A task is running in this section. Actions are locked until it finishes.
semantic_tip: These suggestions compare words. For essay-like or interdisciplinary texts, meaning-based search is much more accurate (one-time {size} download, runs on your computer).
accept_edit_hint: Applies the reviewer's proposed fix (shown above) to the text and marks it accepted.
accept_will_fix_hint: You agree, but the reviewer proposed no text: marks it accepted and changes nothing. Fix it yourself in the editor.
edit_hint: Opens a field with the flagged passage: write your version and click “Apply my text” to replace it in the text.
reject_hint: You disagree: give the reason (it is recorded).
defer_hint: Leaves it for later, without changing the text.
request_failed: The action could not be completed (error {status}). Reload the page and try again.
accept_ai_fix_hint: The AI rewrites the passage to address the finding. You see the change (diff) and accept or discard it; once accepted, the finding is marked edited.
basis_title_only_hint: No abstract or text: the AI cites this work only when the title directly supports the sentence. Use “Complete abstracts” to fetch more information.
refs_missing_basis: {n} reference(s) with only a title (no abstract). Without an abstract the AI can hardly cite them. CANETA can fetch the abstract by DOI (OpenAlex/Crossref), the page content (news, reports) and the open full text.
